checklist.item: Visit https://hackenproof.com/programs/citrea-protocol-and-smart-contracts and extract exact in-scope repos, contract addresses, deployment chains, and all exclusions.
Clone the primary Citrea monorepo from the confirmed GitHub link listed in scope and identify all production Solidity contracts.
Run agents/deep_dive_audit.py --target <cloned-repo>/contracts --mode full to execute recon, Slither, Aderyn, and Mythril.
Invoke Halmos symbolic execution via the same script on bridge, rollup, and settlement contracts flagged by static tools.
Manually audit access-control, proxy upgrade patterns, and role management in governance and sequencer contracts.
Review reentrancy vectors, cross-chain message handling, and any oracle or Bitcoin light-client trust assumptions.
Validate business-logic invariants around deposit/withdrawal finality and EVM state commitment correctness.
Generate minimal PoC transactions or test cases for every confirmed finding before drafting the report.
Prepare the Hackenproof submission with clear reproduction steps, affected contracts, and severity rationale.

Verify the current scope, rules, and payout tiers for the Citrea Protocol & Smart Contracts bug bounty program directly on the Hackenproof website to ensure accuracy and avoid any potential misunderstandings.
Identify the specific smart contracts and repositories included in the scope, focusing on those written in Solidity for the Ethereum and BSC blockchains.
Clone or download the targeted Solidity smart contracts to a local environment for analysis.

Run agents/deep_dive_audit.py on the cloned contracts to perform a deep dive audit, utilizing tools like Slither, Halmos symbolic execution, Mythril, Aderyn static AST analysis, and frontier-LLM review.
Manually review the audit results against a real vulnerability taxonomy, checking for issues such as access control, oracle trust, reentrancy, and business logic vulnerabilities.
Analyze the results to identify potential vulnerabilities and prioritize them based on severity and potential impact on the Citrea Protocol & Smart Contracts.
Document the findings in a clear and concise manner, including steps to reproduce, expected behavior, and actual behavior for each identified vulnerability.
Ensure that the submission meets the Hackenproof requirements, including proper formatting and the provision of any necessary supporting evidence or proof-of-concept code.
Submit the findings through the Hackenproof platform, following their guidelines for bug bounty submissions to be eligible for the $250,000 prize.
Verify current scope, in-scope contracts/addresses, rules, eligibility, and payout tiers directly on https://hackenproof.com/programs/citrea-protocol-and-smart-contracts before any other action
Locate and clone the exact Git repositories and contract sources referenced in the verified program scope
Execute agents/deep_dive_audit.py on all in-scope Solidity contracts targeting Ethereum, BSC, and Base deployments
Run the tool's full pipeline (Slither, Mythril, Halmos, Aderyn, frontier-LLM) to surface reentrancy, access-control, and arithmetic issues
Manually inspect business logic for Citrea-specific flows including deposit/withdrawal, state roots, and cross-chain messaging
Audit oracle, sequencer, and bridge trust assumptions plus any upgradeability or proxy patterns for unauthorized control
Confirm all candidate findings are within the verified scope and produce working reproduction steps or test cases
Prepare submission package with contract addresses, exact commit hashes, severity justification, and exploit impact per Hackenproof template
